mentions.name: InterviewMe
mentions.description: A web app that lets users upload their resume and supporting documents (cover letters, awards, articles) to build an AI conversational agent. Employers can then interview the agent to ask questions and get deep answers about the person's professional work history and experience, beyond what a static resume or LinkedIn profile shows.
mentions.problem: Simple online resumes and LinkedIn profiles don't let people get deep answers about someone's work history and experience.
mentions.audience: Employers who can interview a candidate's AI agent, and job seekers who create their own interview-me profile for free.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building InterviewMe ( https://interviewme.now/ ).  It lets employers interview you via AI and is intended as a better way for people to get deep answers about your work history and experience than they could by looking at a simple online resume or LinkedIn.
mentions.author: maxk42
